channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Rahul Gandhi targets Centre over IndiGo flights chaos, calls it result of ‘monopoly model’
item.description: Once again, it’s ordinary Indians who pay the price - in delays, cancellations and helplessness. India deserves fair competition in every sector, not match-fixing monopolies."

item.title: Chaos continues at Hyderabad Airport as IndiGo cancels 92 flights
item.description: The cancellations for the fourth consecutive day triggered a protest by passengers at the terminal building. Angry passengers had heated arguments with the indigo staff.

item.title: RBI slashes India’s inflation forecast to 2 pc for 2025-26
item.description: The RBI’s monetary policy committee (MPC) on Friday slashed its forecast for India’s inflation rate for the financial year 2025-26 to 2 per cent -- from 2.6 per cent predicted in October due to the sharp decline in food prices and the GST rate cuts playing out.

item.title: Drop colonial title Lord from textbooks, govt records’: BJP MP in RS
item.description: Raising the issue during Zero Hour in the Rajya Sabha, BJP MP from Odisha, Sujeet Kumar, called for an urgent review of school textbooks, government documents, and official websites that continue to refer to British Governors-General and Viceroys with the colonial honorific 'Lord'.

item.title: Putin begins packed Day 2 Delhi agenda with Rashtrapati Bhavan welcome; set for PM Modi talks
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin will be given a ceremonial reception at Rashtrapati Bhavan on Friday, followed by official talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

item.title: Man killed in targeted shooting in Australia’s Queensland
item.description: The Queensland Police Service (QPS) said that emergency services attended a property in the suburb of Slacks Creek, 20 km southeast of the state capital of Brisbane, at around 1:15 a.m. local time on Friday and located a man with an apparent gunshot wound.

item.title: Russian President Vladimir Putin accorded ceremonial welcome at Rashtrapati Bhavan
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin, on a two-day visit to India, was accorded a ceremonial welcome at the forecourt of Rashtrapati Bhavan on Friday.

item.title: Air pollution can heighten anxiety and trigger panic-like symptoms: Doctors
item.description: Amid continuing poor air quality in the national capital, doctors on Friday noted that air pollution can not only harm your lungs or lead to cardiac illness but can also heighten anxiety and trigger panic-like symptoms.

item.title: IndiGo cancels all domestic flights departing from Delhi Airport till midnight today amid disruptions
item.description: Delhi Airport took to social media 'X' and said, "IndiGo domestic flights departing from Delhi Airport on 5th December 2025 are cancelled till midnight today (till 23:59 hours). Operations for all other carriers remain as scheduled."

item.title: Temperature expected to dip by 2-4 degrees C across Bihar in next 48 hours, cold wave alert issued
item.description: With December setting in, winter has tightened its grip across North India, including Bihar, where cold conditions are expected to intensify further in the coming days.
